text: The island catches the light. The sun now casts soft shadows that follow the hour, warm where it falls and cool in the shade; colours are deeper, glowing items and lit windows bloom at night, and when you zoom in close on a village, what lies in front of it and behind it softens like a model on a table. Your phone picks how much of this it can run; turn each part on or off yourself in the frame counter (long press the title, open the World).
